name: discount-cap
behaviour: A discount at the cap is applied once, and one above the cap is refused with no discount made.
derivedFrom: owned fixture suite: PROMISE-02 (no discount above the cap) and PROMISE-05 (a discount within the cap is granted as stated)

actor.description: The actor asking for the discounts (it owns both orders).

capPath.description: The discount route of the order discounted at the cap (POST).

overCapPath.description: The discount route of the order asked for more than the cap (POST).

overCapPercent.description: A percentage above the cap: refused.

effectSource.description: The observer source that records the action's effect (http-egress: a payment call on the request path).

effectOperation.description: The operation that source records for the effect (send for an outbound call, insert for an audit row).

effectName.description: The effect's exact name: the destination host for http-egress, the action for an audit table.

resourcePrefix.description: The resource prefix every effect of this action carries (such as POST /v1/refunds/ for http-egress): the twin shows it selects, and the refusal must make none.

successStatus.description: The status of an applied discount.

refusalStatuses.description: The statuses that count as a refusal.
